timeWindows.label: 00:00-06:00 Night base load
timeWindows.designMeaning: Base load during no-solar hours; drives battery reserve and overnight autonomy.

timeWindows.label: 06:00-09:00 Morning ramp
timeWindows.designMeaning: Morning startup load; check motor starts, pumps, HVAC, and grid demand spike.

timeWindows.label: 09:00-15:00 Solar production window
timeWindows.designMeaning: Best window for direct PV self-consumption and process scheduling.

timeWindows.label: 15:00-18:00 Afternoon shoulder
timeWindows.designMeaning: PV falls while business load remains high; BESS may smooth ramp and protect peak.

timeWindows.label: 18:00-22:00 Evening peak
timeWindows.designMeaning: High-value BESS discharge window for TOU, demand control, and resilience.

timeWindows.label: 22:00-24:00 Late night
timeWindows.designMeaning: Late base load; reserve policy determines how much BESS can discharge.

appliances.label: Air conditioners / HVAC
appliances.designMeaning: Large flexible load; affects PV self-consumption, comfort backup, and staged restoration.

appliances.label: Refrigeration / cold room
appliances.designMeaning: Usually critical and continuous; sets backup reserve and transfer continuity requirement.

appliances.label: Pumps / motors
appliances.designMeaning: Motor inrush affects PCS overload, STS transfer, breaker coordination, and staged restart.

appliances.label: EV chargers
appliances.designMeaning: Good controllable load for PV hours; avoid charging during outage reserve periods.
